biggest_catch: The friend must complete the referral exactly as described in the referral message on share.salalcu.org (the T&Cs defer the qualification details there); if the friend's account doesn't qualify, no $100 gift card is paid to either party.
catches: Referrer must be a US legal resident 18+ and a Salal member; employees of Salal and affiliates cannot participate.
Referrer may refer max 25 friends per session and 500 total over the life of the program.
Referrer earns a $100 Visa digital gift card per VALID referral; friend also receives $100; referrer cap is $500 in rewards per year.
Rewards are Visa DIGITAL gift cards - terms state rewards 'have no monetary value and may not be redeemed for cash' and are non-transferable.
Self-referrals, fake/fictitious accounts, bulk/spam distribution, and referring strangers are prohibited and can void rewards.
Rewards subject to verification; Salal may delay or refuse a reward for investigation or any reason.
Members responsible for federal/state/local taxes on rewards.
Program can be cancelled, modified, or terminated at any time.

The exact friend qualification (account type/actions) is stated in the referral message on share.salalcu.org, not in the T&Cs PDF; the prior form-based program required the friend to open a consumer checking account.

steps: Visit share.salalcu.org and follow the on-screen instructions to generate your personal referral link.
Share the link personally with friends, family, or colleagues (max 25 per session; no bulk/spam).
Each friend completes the referral exactly as described in the referral message (account opening/qualification steps shown there).
Receive a $100 Visa digital gift card per valid referral (up to $500 per year); friend also receives $100.
timing: No fixed payout clock in terms; rewards subject to verification and may be delayed for investigation.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: No fixed payout clock in terms; rewards subject to verification and may be delayed for investigation. — the stated payout timeline runs multiple weeks.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
Volume constraint noted in terms: cap is $500 in rewards per year — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
